The assigned examples make no stronger EM claim. This verifies authoring context only, not independent acceptance.

Read the current BCS-22 A-page summary and the actual variational-family/ELBO definition and correlated-Gaussian variance counterexample. The imported interface requires support on the target and finite log integrals; mean-field optimization does not guarantee calibration or preservation of dependence. The local example independently recomputes the rho=1/2 optimum. This verifies authoring context only, not independent acceptance.

Read the current BCS-23 A-page summary and the complete actual unique-interior-maximum Laplace theorem and proof. Its leading equivalent assumes a unique interior global maximum, positive-definite negative Hessian, local quadratic domination and a global gap, and carries Countable Choice through the Gaussian/Lebesgue route. The local counterexample has two equal full-rank modes and does not apply that theorem outside its hypotheses. This verifies authoring context only, not independent acceptance.

The current A-page carrier is present at library/bayesian-computational-statistics/approximate-bayesian-computation-and-simulation-based-inference.md and its full summary was read. It requires a proper prior-simulator model on standard Borel parameter/data spaces, measurable Euclidean summary, closed tolerance ball, and positive prior-predictive acceptance for the normalized target. I read the actual ABC definition, rejection algorithm, IID rejection theorem, zero-tolerance density-limit theorem, and sufficient-summary theorem and their proofs. The two assigned examples use only the finite tolerance-conditioned target and, for rejection-law identification, the IID/p>0 theorem; they claim neither zero-tolerance convergence nor sufficient-summary recovery. This verifies current page context, not independent acceptance.

Read the current BCS-54 A-page summary and the actual same-scale scalar ledger definition, signed pathwise telescope theorem, and MSE covariance identity. The imported distinction is adjacent reference targets with no automatic independence, centering or variance-sum assumption; the new metric result proves its own triangle inequality and retains the MSE caveat. This verifies authoring context only, not independent acceptance.

Read the actual statement and complete proof. Read the actual lemma statement and proof. Under Countable Choice it normalizes the Gaussian quadratic with positive-definite Hessian; the example uses its one-dimensional case at precision 8n and declares Countable Choice explicitly.

Read the complete current theorem statement and proof. It assumes a unique interior global maximum, positive amplitude, a positive-definite negative Hessian, local quadratic domination and a global off-mode gap, and it uses Countable Choice only. The counterexample verifies two equal interior global maxima with h''=-8 at each, so the uniqueness premise is exactly what fails.
